current_prompt.body:
- bin capacity C = 10
- First Fit algorithm
- optimal packing
APPLY the First Fit algorithm to the item sequence [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] using bin capacity C = 10 and RECORD the resulting packing.
DETERMINE the optimal packing for the same items and bin capacity that minimizes the total number of bins and RECORD the optimal packing.
CALCULATE the gap between the First Fit packing and the optimal packing in terms of number of bins used and REPORT the gap.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes the First Fit algorithm to use more bins than the optimal packing.
INCLUDE a self-test that VERIFY both packings use all items exactly once and RESPECT the capacity constraint.
